newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Thursday:

Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said the Commission had sent a reasoned opinion to Spain concerning its law on pay-TV and on digital television services. Van der Pas said Spain's answer to the formal notice sent in June was unsatisfactory.

Asked to react to the U.S. decision to end sanctions against Italy's Stet SpA, accused of breaking article IV of the Helms Burton Act, spokesman Peter Guilford said STET's agreement to use ITT Corp's telephone equipment system in Cuba had the advantage of deepening the penetration of the Cuban market and thereby fit in with EU's general policy towards Cuba.
Van der Pas briefed on the Commission's instructions in the field on labelling of genetically modified organisms.
In answer to a question he said he did not yet know whether those instructions would interact with the novel food legislation.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/677: United Kingdom - VAT - works of art, antique and collectors' items.
- IP/97/680: Digital television: Commission sends reasoned opinion to Spain.
- IP/97/686: Commission initiates dispute settlement procedure over Czech import duties.
- IP/97/687: Professional qualifications: infringement proceedings against France and Italy.
- IP/97/688: Portugal: ECU 17 million from the Cohesion Fund for treatment of solid waste in the Algarve.
- IP/97/689: Spain: ECU 149 million in subsidies from the Cohesion Fund for two transport projects.
- IP/97/690: Agreement to improve paid employment in agriculture.
- IP/97/691: Commission decides to investigate regional transport aid to Volvo Trucks in support of the company's transport costs of inbound and outbound material within and from assisted areas.
- IP/97/692: The Commission opens a procedure against aid for the construction of Germany's LEUNA 2000 refinery.
- IP/97/694: Commission adopts - as first European Institution - a green housekeeping plan for its administration.
- Eurostat - Statistics in focus - External trade No 1997-4: EU trade relations with Hong Kong, China and taiwan.
- Eurostat - Distributive trade and services No 5,6,7-1997.
- European Community Youth Orchestra.
- ME97/24.7: Midday Express.
